title: S.I. No. 7 of 2026 - Fiscal Incentives (Brice and Company Limited) Order
text:
83
Fiscal Incentives (Brice and Company Limited) Order
SAINT LUCIA
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT, 2026, No. 7
[ 26th January, 2026 ]
In exercise of the powers conferred under sections 5 and 6 of
the Fiscal Incentives Act, Cap. 15.16, Cabinet makes this Order:
Citation
1. This Order may be cited as the Fiscal Incentives (Brice and
Company Limited) Order, 2026.
Approved enterprise
2. Brice and Company Limited is declared to be an approved
enterprise.
Approved products
3. The following products are declared to be approved products
of Brice and Company Limited —
(a) beams;
(b) chain link fencing;
(c) columns;
(d) galvanized nails;
(e) garbage bins;
(f) guard rails;
(g) guttering;
(h) mats;
(i) metal roofing;
(j) metal studs;
(k) metal tracks;
(l) steel cladding;

84
Fiscal Incentives (Brice and Company Limited) Order
(m) steel purlins;
(n) stirrups;
(o) plastic crates;
(p) water tanks.
Declared benefit with regard to income tax
4. Subject to section 6, the declared benefit with regard to income
tax is a seventy-five per cent waiver of income tax for a period of five
years commencing from the 1st day of November, 2025 and terminating
on the 31st day of October, 2030.
Declared benefit with regard to customs duty
5.—(1) Subject to subsection (2) and section 6, the declared benefit
with regard to customs duty is —
(a) a one hundred per cent waiver of customs duty on plant,
machinery, equipment, tools, spare parts for machinery
and raw and packaging materials;
(b) a fifty per cent waiver of customs duty on fifteen pick-
up vans;
(c) a seventy-five per cent waiver of customs duty on twelve
flat-bed trucks;
(d) a seventy-five per cent waiver of customs duty on one
tractor-head truck;
(e) a seventy-five per cent waiver of customs duty on ten
forklifts.
(2) The benefit declared under subsection (1) is applicable for a
period of five years commencing from the 1st day of November, 2025
and terminating on the 31st day of October, 2030.
Conditions
6. The declared benefits under sections 4 and 5 are subject to the
following conditions —
(a) in the case of section 5(1), that visible signage of Brice
and Company Limited is displayed on each vehicle;

85
Fiscal Incentives (Brice and Company Limited) Order
(b) that the Department of Commerce approves the imported
or locally purchased items;
(c) that Brice and Company Limited complies with the
statutory or regulatory requirements, including, the
provision of statistical information to the Department of
Commerce;
(d) that Brice and Company Limited provides data and
complies with the monitoring requirements of the
Department of Commerce and any other agency of the
Government.
Made this 16th day of January, 2026.
AGOSTA DEGAZON,
Cabinet Secretary.
